title: I Am Thine, O Lord
lyrics_original: And it told Thy love to me;
And be closer drawn to Thee.
To the cross where Thou hast died;
By the pow’r of grace divine;
And my will be lost in Thine.
To the cross where Thou hast died;
That before Thy throne I spend,
I commune as friend with friend!
To the cross where Thou hast died;
‘Ere Thee face to face I see;
‘Ere I rest in peace with Thee.
To the cross where Thou hast died;

bible_verses.english: Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch can't bear fruit by itself, unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me.
Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners; and purify your hearts, you double-minded.
that I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming conformed to his death;

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, thank You for speaking Your love into my heart and claiming me as Your own. Lord, I long to know You more deeply and to walk closely with You each day. Draw me nearer to the grace of the cross, where Your mercy shines brightest. Lift my faith above daily distractions so I may abide peacefully in Your presence. In Jesus' name, Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Heavenly Father, thank You for speaking Your love into my heart and claiming me as Your own. Lord, I long to know You more deeply and to walk closely with You each day. devotional.reflection_english: Hearing the gentle voice of God is the beginning of a lifelong journey of intimacy. This classic hymn reminds us that belonging to Christ is not a static milestone, but an ongoing desire to draw nearer to His heart. As we contemplate His love poured out at the cross, our faith is invited to reach upward and rest deeper in Him. Today, let this song be your honest prayer to abide more closely in the presence of the One who calls you His own.
